name: Right Place, Wrong Time
summary: Sergeant Ulka asks you to hear about the situation on Alcaz Isle. The rest of the mission details are reserved for those who need to know.

sections.title: Ulka's Briefing
sections.body: Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up when she speaks with you on Alcaz Isle. You offer her a hand, but she swats it away. She says she will bring you up to date, while keeping the rest of the mission details close. Your duty to the Warchief awaits.

faq.q: Who is asking me to catch up?
faq.answer: Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up as she speaks with you.

faq.q: What is happening on Alcaz Isle?
faq.answer: Sergeant Ulka says she will catch you up on the situation on Alcaz Isle.

faq.q: Why won't Ulka share all the mission details?
faq.answer: Sergeant Ulka says the remaining mission details are need to know.

faq.q: What does Ulka ask of me?
faq.answer: Speak with Sergeant Ulka to learn more about the situation on Alcaz Isle.

faq.q: What does Ulka ask about my duty?
faq.answer: Sergeant Ulka asks whether you are ready to do your duty to the Warchief.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, Sergeant Ulka asks whether you are ready to do your duty to the Warchief.

attribution: In-game quest text: Right Place, Wrong Time
